create.name: Meditation Vacation
create.bio:
Meditation Vacation is the guided meditation channel of Christian Thomas, a British meditation voice who began uploading to YouTube in March 2015 and has since published several hundred recordings. He says he found his own way out of a long period of low mood, anxiety and broken sleep through meditation, and he started the channel to pass on what had helped him. His recordings are mostly long and gently paced, narrated over soft soundscapes, and many are meant to be listened to in bed with the screen switched off.

The catalogue leans towards sleep: extended talk-downs, body scans, sleep stories set on trains, boats and lake shores, and a large set of lucid dreaming journeys, some of them framed as meeting a spirit guide or exploring astral travel. There are also short morning practices for grounding and positivity, chakra and higher-self meditations, and law of attraction affirmations. Besides YouTube, his work is on the main streaming services, and his website sells individual downloads and bundles and offers a low-cost membership that unlocks around a hundred of his meditations.

flags: Listed as a channel, 'Meditation Vacation', not as Christian Thomas: his only usable image is the channel logo (YouTube avatar); his own site's photos are on Wix (refused) and his Insight Timer photo is never used. The earlier dropped plan was an individual listing; owner may prefer to hold for a photo and list him by name.

Health restore: under the new rule his sleep, anxiety and overthinking titles are wellbeing wording. He writes openly about his own past depression and plans a book on it; no cure claims found on the pages read.
Email contact@meditationvacation.co.uk is given as the site owner's contact in the privacy text on the contact page (brand inbox); the page also has a form.
Some lucid dreaming titles mention astral projection and spirit guides; kept as dreamwork and mediumship-spirits.
Store product pages give only a title and price, so descriptions are kept short and general.
